page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc8i.48xlarge is a dedicated bare metal instance within the ECS Bare Metal family, built on the x86_64 architecture. The host is powered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, supplying a total of 192 dedicated virtual cores. With an aggregate memory capacity of 512.0 GB, the instance provides approximately 2.67 GB of RAM per vCPU, placing it firmly into a compute-dense configuration that prioritizes massive multi-threaded execution.

Networking performance is anchored by a high-throughput 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating heavy ingress and egress traffic demands. The server does not bundle any onboard local storage, necessitating reliance on networked block or object storage solutions for persistent data. Accelerators are also omitted, with the configuration containing zero dedicated GPUs and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included out of the box.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance offers significant cost efficiency for parallelized processing pipelines by dedicating 192 physical execution threads without virtualization contention overhead. The primary design tradeoff centers on the compute-to-storage balance: systems requiring high-throughput disk access must design around remote storage attachments. This configuration is strategically matched for compute-heavy batch processing, distributed compilation, electronic design automation (EDA), scientific simulations, and large-scale parallel analytics.
